# Documentation Guidelines for Ezkey Project

## Language Policy

**All Markdown documentation in the Ezkey project MUST be written in English.**

This policy applies to:
- README files
- Architecture documentation (docs/ folder)
- API documentation
- Contributing guides
- Issue and pull request descriptions
- Code comments in Markdown format
- Any other Markdown files (.md) in the project

### Rationale

- **Global Accessibility**: English ensures the widest possible audience can understand and contribute to the project
- **Consistency**: A single language prevents fragmentation and confusion across documentation
- **Open Source Standards**: English is the de facto standard for international open source projects
- **Developer Collaboration**: Facilitates collaboration among contributors from different countries

### Enforcement

- Pull requests containing Markdown documentation in languages other than English will not be merged
- Reviewers should check that all new or modified Markdown files are in English
- Use automated checks where possible to enforce this policy

### Exceptions

There are **no exceptions** to this rule. All documentation must be in English, regardless of:
- The contributor's native language
- The target audience
- The specific module or component

### Getting Help

If you need assistance translating documentation to English:
- Use translation tools as a starting point
- Ask other contributors for review
- Request help in the pull request comments

## Other Documentation Standards

### Formatting

- Use proper Markdown syntax
- Follow the project's style guide (see [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md))
- Use UTF-8 encoding without BOM
- Use LF (Unix) line endings

### Structure

- Include a clear title and introduction
- Use appropriate heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3, etc.)
- Provide examples where applicable
- Keep documentation up-to-date with code changes

### Best Practices

- Write clear, concise, and accurate documentation
- Use proper grammar and spelling
- Include code examples when relevant
- Link to related documentation
- Update documentation as part of feature development, not as an afterthought

---

**Remember: English is mandatory for all Markdown documentation in Ezkey.**
